finance_accounts_account_type_fallback.description: Fallback account-type label shown when a financial account has no provider-supplied type.

finance_accounts_add_account.description: Action and accessibility label for connecting another financial account.

finance_accounts_credit_account_type.description: Short metadata label identifying the kind of connection in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details. The value is Credit bureau.

finance_accounts_credit_back.description: Accessible label for the back button on the shared ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details screen. It returns the user to the Accounts list.

finance_accounts_credit_bureau.description: Account-type value for an Experian credit-report connection in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details. A credit bureau is an organization that maintains consumer credit reports.

finance_accounts_credit_follow_up.description: Short button in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details that opens a conversation to ask ChatGPT about the user's credit information.

finance_accounts_credit_information.description: Heading above available provider-reported credit-health metrics in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details.

finance_accounts_credit_institution.description: Short metadata label for the credit bureau's name in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details.

finance_accounts_credit_institution_name.description: Name of the credit bureau shown in ChatGPT Personal Finance Accounts and credit-account details. Experian is a brand name; do not translate it.

finance_accounts_credit_load_error.defaultMessage: لم نتمكّن من تحميل درجتك الائتمانية.
finance_accounts_credit_load_error.description: Error message in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details when the normalized credit report request fails. A Retry button appears below it.

finance_accounts_credit_loading.description: Screen-reader status while ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details loads the user's normalized credit report.

finance_accounts_credit_metric_all_accou.description: Short secondary label below a reported total balance or available-credit amount in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details. It refers to accounts included in the credit report.

finance_accounts_credit_metric_available.description: Short label for the provider-reported credit remaining available in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details.

finance_accounts_credit_metric_credit_ch.description: Short label for the provider-reported credit inquiry count in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details. Do not imply that all inquiries are hard checks.

finance_accounts_credit_metric_credit_hi.description: Short label for the provider-reported age of the oldest credit account in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details.

finance_accounts_credit_metric_credit_us.description: Short label for the reported portion of available revolving credit in use in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details.

finance_accounts_credit_metric_oldest_ac.description: Short secondary label beneath credit-history age in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details. The value describes the oldest reported account, not an average.

finance_accounts_credit_metric_on_time.description: Short secondary label beneath a payment-history percentage in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details. It explains that the percentage describes payments made on time.

finance_accounts_credit_metric_payment_h.description: Short label for the provider-reported percentage of on-time payments in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details.

finance_accounts_credit_metric_reported_.description: Short secondary label under the credit-check count in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details. No specific lookback period or hard-versus-soft classification is known.

finance_accounts_credit_metric_total_bal.description: Short label for total provider-reported credit-account balances in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details.

finance_accounts_credit_metric_utilizati.description: Short secondary label beneath the reported credit-usage percentage in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details.

finance_accounts_credit_multiple_inquiri.description: Credit-check value in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details when the reported inquiry count is zero or greater than one. The count is an already localized whole number.

finance_accounts_credit_multiple_months.description: Credit-history age in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details when the oldest reported account is under one year old and its age is not exactly one month. The months placeholder is an already localized whole number.

finance_accounts_credit_multiple_years.description: Credit-history age in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details when the oldest reported account is a whole number of years old, greater than one. The years placeholder is an already localized whole number.

finance_accounts_credit_one_inquiry.description: Credit-check value in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details when the report contains exactly one inquiry.

finance_accounts_credit_one_month.description: Credit-history age in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details when the oldest reported account is exactly one completed month old.

finance_accounts_credit_one_year.description: Credit-history age in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details when the oldest reported account is exactly twelve completed months old.

finance_accounts_credit_percentage.description: A provider-reported percentage value in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details. The percentage placeholder is an already localized number; preserve the percent meaning.

finance_accounts_credit_remove.description: Button in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details that asks the user to confirm removing their credit connection and locally stored reports. It does not remove bank accounts.

finance_accounts_credit_remove_cancel.description: Short button in the ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account removal dialog that keeps the connection and closes the confirmation.

finance_accounts_credit_remove_confirm.description: Short destructive confirmation button in the ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account removal dialog. Selecting it starts removing the user's credit connection and locally stored reports.

finance_accounts_credit_remove_descripti.defaultMessage: سيؤدي هذا إلى إزالة ربطك الائتماني وتقاريرك الائتمانية المخزّنة محليًا من ChatGPT. ولن يقطع اتصال حساباتك المصرفية.
finance_accounts_credit_remove_descripti.description: Body of the confirmation dialog for removing the user's credit account in ChatGPT Personal Finance. Explain the scope calmly and precisely; do not imply deletion of the credit bureau's own records.

finance_accounts_credit_remove_error.defaultMessage: لم نتمكّن من إزالة حسابك الائتماني. حاول مرة أخرى.
finance_accounts_credit_remove_error.description: Error in the ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account removal confirmation when the request fails. The existing report remains visible, and the user may retry or cancel.

finance_accounts_credit_remove_title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog opened from ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details before removing the user's credit connection.

finance_accounts_credit_report_date.description: Short metadata label for the provider-reported date of the credit report in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details.

finance_accounts_credit_report_date_unav.description: Compact status below the Experian score in ChatGPT Personal Finance Accounts when neither the provider's report date nor the score date is available.

finance_accounts_credit_reported_relativ.description: Compact status below the Experian score in ChatGPT Personal Finance Accounts. The date placeholder is an already localized relative day phrase, such as 2 days ago. It describes the provider's report date, falling back to the score date, and is not an app synchronization time.

finance_accounts_credit_reported_today.description: Compact status below the Experian score in ChatGPT Personal Finance Accounts when the provider's report date is today. Use the score date only when no report date is available. This is not the time ChatGPT last synchronized.

finance_accounts_credit_reported_yesterd.description: Compact status below the Experian score in ChatGPT Personal Finance Accounts when the provider's report date is yesterday. Use the score date only when no report date is available. This is not the time ChatGPT last synchronized.

finance_accounts_credit_row_accessibilit.description: Screen-reader label for the credit-bureau row in ChatGPT Personal Finance Accounts. Selecting the row opens credit-account details. The score placeholder is a localized score or a privacy mask, not always a number.

finance_accounts_credit_score_date.description: Short metadata label for the provider-reported date of the credit score in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details. This is not an app synchronization time.

finance_accounts_credit_score_model.description: Short metadata label for the reported scoring model, such as VantageScore 3.0, in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details.

finance_accounts_credit_summary.description: Subtitle below Experian in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details. The score placeholder contains a localized score or a privacy mask; it may not be numeric.

finance_accounts_credit_unavailable.description: Neutral empty state in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details when the user no longer has an available credit report.

finance_accounts_credit_years_and_months.description: Compact credit-history age in ChatGPT Personal Finance credit-account details when the oldest reported account is at least one year old with additional completed months. Both placeholders are localized whole numbers. Use short, unambiguous year and month units that fit beside the metric label.

finance_accounts_empty.defaultMessage: لا توجد حسابات مرتبطة حتى الآن.
finance_accounts_empty.description: Message shown when the user has no connected financial accounts.

finance_accounts_financial_institution.description: Fallback name shown when a connected financial institution has no available name.

finance_accounts_load_error.description: Error message shown when the Finance Accounts list cannot be loaded.

finance_accounts_loading_accessibility_l.description: Screen-reader label announced while the Finance Accounts list is loading.

finance_accounts_pending_institution_acc.description: Screen-reader label combining a pending financial institution's name and synchronization status.

finance_accounts_repair.description: Action that starts repairing a disconnected financial institution.

finance_accounts_repair_description_with.defaultMessage: انقطع اتصالك بـ {institutionName}، وستحتاج إلى تسجيل الدخول إلى البنك مجددًا.
finance_accounts_repair_description_with.description: Explanation shown when a named financial institution connection needs to be repaired.
finance_accounts_repair_description_with.example: Your connection with Community Bank was disrupted, and you will need to sign into the bank again.

finance_accounts_repair_description_with.defaultMessage: انقطع اتصالك بالبنك، وستحتاج إلى إعادة تسجيل الدخول إليه.
finance_accounts_repair_description_with.description: Explanation shown when an unnamed financial institution connection needs to be repaired.

finance_accounts_repair_title.description: Heading shown when a financial institution connection needs to be repaired.

finance_accounts_retry.description: Action that retries loading the Finance Accounts list.

finance_accounts_section_asset_share.description: Percentage of total assets represented by a section. The placeholder is an already localized number or comparison, such as 25, 0.4, <0.1, or >99.9, without a percent sign.

finance_accounts_section_cash.description: Heading for cash and deposit financial accounts.

finance_accounts_section_collapsed_acces.description: Screen-reader label for a collapsed financial account section.

finance_accounts_section_credit_score.description: Short heading for the collapsible credit-report section in ChatGPT Personal Finance Accounts. Users can expand it to open their connected credit bureau.

finance_accounts_section_expanded_access.description: Screen-reader label for an expanded financial account section.

finance_accounts_section_liability_share.description: Percentage of total liabilities represented by a section. The placeholder is an already localized number or comparison, such as 25, 0.4, <0.1, or >99.9, without a percent sign.

finance_accounts_section_loans.description: Heading for loan and mortgage financial accounts.

finance_accounts_section_other_assets.description: Heading for financial accounts representing other assets.

finance_accounts_section_real_estate.description: Heading for financial accounts representing real-estate assets.

finance_accounts_share_greater_than.description: Share above the largest displayed partial percentage but below 100 percent. The placeholder is an already localized number, such as 99.9 or 99,9. Preserve the greater-than meaning without a percent sign; the surrounding section label supplies it.

finance_accounts_share_less_than.description: Share smaller than the displayed precision. The placeholder is an already localized number, such as 0.1 or 0,1. Preserve the less-than meaning without a percent sign; the surrounding section label supplies it.

finance_accounts_status_analyzing.description: Status shown while a connected financial account's data is being analyzed.

finance_accounts_status_not_synced.description: Status shown when a connected financial account has no usable account-specific synchronization timestamp.

finance_accounts_status_repair_needed.description: Status and screen-reader label for a disconnected financial institution.

finance_accounts_status_sync_failed.description: Status and screen-reader label for a financial account whose last synchronization failed.

finance_accounts_status_syncing.description: Status shown while a connected financial account is synchronizing.

finance_accounts_updated_just_now.description: Synchronization timestamp shown when a financial account was updated less than one minute ago.

finance_accounts_updated_multiple_days_a.description: Synchronization timestamp shown when a financial account was updated multiple days ago.

finance_accounts_updated_multiple_hours_.description: Synchronization timestamp shown when a financial account was updated multiple hours ago.

finance_accounts_updated_multiple_minute.description: Synchronization timestamp shown when a financial account was updated multiple minutes ago.

finance_accounts_updated_one_day_ago.description: Synchronization timestamp shown when a financial account was updated exactly one day ago.

finance_accounts_updated_one_hour_ago.description: Synchronization timestamp shown when a financial account was updated exactly one hour ago.

finance_accounts_updated_one_minute_ago.description: Synchronization timestamp shown when a financial account was updated exactly one minute ago.

finance_accounts_updated_recently.description: Fallback synchronization timestamp shown when a financial account has no usable update time.
